items.title: MI5 chief: Iran now targeting UK military sites; RAF Fairford plot 'not unique'
items.summary: MI5 Director General Ken McCallum said in his annual threat speech Tuesday that Tehran is seeking to hit military sites in Britain — a 'major shift this year' beyond its usual targets (dissidents, media, Jewish sites hit by proxies). He said the suspected September plot against the U.S.-run RAF Fairford air base is 'not unique,' with other examples 'not just in the U.K. but around the world.' McCallum said Iran's proxy attempts in Britain are low-level for now but warned Iran's IRGC has shown stronger capabilities closer to home. Separately, Iran summoned British Ambassador Hugo Shorter, warning it could 'seriously reconsider' bilateral relations unless the U.K. provides evidence linking Tehran to the Fairford plot. Seven men in their 20s were arrested and released on bail; 50+ arrested over Iran-linked plots in the past year. The U.S. pulled its bombers from Fairford after the incident.
